As a mom of two teenagers, I don’t have to ask parents about raising kids in a digital world—I’m living it.

For far too long, Big Tech has chosen profits over protecting our children. Congress cannot continue to sit on the sidelines, doing nothing is not an option.
posts.summary: Demands Congress regulate Big Tech to protect children from social media harms

I welcome today’s proposal from the OCC and FDIC to restore a more practical Community Reinvestment Act framework. Community banks should be focused on expanding access to credit, supporting small businesses, and strengthening local communities, not navigating unnecessary regulatory burdens or subsidizing activist causes. 

This proposal is an important step toward ensuring CRA resources are directed where Congress intended: helping the communities they are meant to serve.
posts.summary: Supports deregulation of Community Reinvestment Act framework
